ops.oldText: 12.4 For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
ops.newText: 12.4 For twelve months after the end of a person's involvement in the Services, neither party will knowingly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in performing or receiving the Services. Nothing in this Section 12.4 restricts either party from hiring or engaging any person who responds to a general advertisement or other recruitment activity not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or who approaches that party on an unsolicited basis.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed this to a mutual, solicitation-only restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, running twelve months from the end of that involvement, with the usual general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. Our playbook does not accept one-way no-hire style restrictions on us covering all Vendor personnel, and this also sits awkwardly with Section 12.3.
input.summary: Narrow one-way 18-month no-solicit/no-engage to mutual 12-month solicitation-only with carve-outs
